CHEVAL_GRAND_SLAY_KEYWORD_STAMINA.title: Stamina
CHEVAL_GRAND_SLAY_KEYWORD_STAMINA.descri: Each play consumes 1 Stamina. When Stamina is depleted, the card enters the [gold]Fate pile[/gold].
CHEVAL_GRAND_SLAY_KEYWORD_REST_PILE.desc: Cards enter this pile when their Stamina is depleted. Cards and powers can restore their Stamina and move them out. This pile is cleared at the end of combat.
